parameters.name: AttemptInterval
parameters.description: The retry interval on errors. Unit: seconds. Default value: 30.

parameters.name: Calendar
parameters.description: The custom calendar that can be optionally specified for the cron type.

parameters.name: ClassName
parameters.description:
The full path of the node interface class.

This field is required only for Java node types, and the full path must be specified.

parameters.name: ConsumerSize
parameters.description: The advanced configuration for parallel grid tasks. The number of threads for a single trigger on a single machine. Default value: 5.

parameters.name: ContactInfo
parameters.description:
The contact information for the node.
><notice>This field is deprecated.</notice>

sub_parameters.name: Ding
sub_parameters.description: The webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot in the DingTalk group for alert contacts. References: [DingTalk development documentation](https://open.dingtalk.com/document/org/application-types).

sub_parameters.name: UserMail
sub_parameters.description: The email address of the user.

sub_parameters.name: UserPhone
sub_parameters.description: The mobile phone number of the user.

parameters.name: Content
parameters.description:
- If the node type is python, shell, or k8s, specify the corresponding script content.
- If the node type is golang, the content format example is {"jobName":"HelloWorld"}.

parameters.name: DataOffset
parameters.description: The time offset that can be optionally specified for the cron type. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The node description.

parameters.name: DispatcherSize
parameters.description: The advanced configuration for parallel grid tasks. The number of subtask dispatch threads. Default value: 5.

parameters.name: ExecuteMode
parameters.description:
The node execution mode. Valid values:

- **standalone**: standalone
- **broadcatst**: broadcast
- **parallel**: visual MapReduce
- **batch**: MapReduce
- **shard**: shard

parameters.name: FailEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the failure alert. Valid values:

- **true**: Enabled.
- **false**: Disabled.

parameters.name: FailTimes
parameters.description: The number of consecutive failures before an alert is triggered.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The application ID. You can obtain the application ID on the Application Management page in the console.

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The node ID. You can obtain the node ID on the Task Management page in the console.

parameters.name: MaxAttempt
parameters.description: The maximum number of retries on errors. Set this parameter based on your business requirements.

parameters.name: MaxConcurrency
parameters.description: The maximum number of concurrently running instances. Default value: 1. This means that if the previous trigger has not finished running, the next trigger is not performed even if the scheduled time has arrived.

parameters.name: MissWorkerEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the no-available-machine alert. Valid values:
- **true**: Enabled.
- **false**: Disabled.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The node name.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the console.

parameters.name: NamespaceSource
parameters.description: This parameter is required only for special third-party users.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The advanced configuration for parallel grid tasks. The number of subtasks pulled per request. Default value: 100.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: The user-defined parameters that can be obtained at runtime.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description:
The node priority. Valid values:
- **1**: low
- **5**: medium
- **10**: high
- **15**: very high

parameters.name: QueueSize
parameters.description: The advanced configuration for parallel grid tasks. The maximum cache size of the subtask queue. Default value: 10000.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID.

parameters.name: SendChannel
parameters.description: The alert notification method. Currently, only sms is supported.

parameters.name: SuccessNoticeEnable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the success notification.

parameters.name: TaskAttemptInterval
parameters.description: The advanced configuration for parallel grid tasks. The retry interval for failed subtasks.

parameters.name: TaskDispatchMode
parameters.description: The advanced configuration for parallel grid tasks. Specifies the push model or pull model.

parameters.name: TaskMaxAttempt
parameters.description: The advanced configuration for parallel grid tasks. The number of retries for failed subtasks.

parameters.name: Template
parameters.description: The custom task template for k8s node types.

parameters.name: TimeExpression
parameters.description:
The time expression. Set the time expression based on the selected time type.

- **cron**: Specify a standard cron expression. Online verification is supported.
- **api**: No time expression is required.
- **fixed_rate**: Specify a fixed frequency value in seconds. For example, 30 indicates that the node is triggered every 30 seconds.
- **second_delay**: Specify a fixed delay in seconds before each execution (1s to 60s).

parameters.name: TimeType
parameters.description:
The time configuration type. Valid values:

- **1**: cron
- **3**: fix_rate
- **4**: second_delay
- **5**: one_time
- **100**: api

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: The timeout threshold. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: TimeoutEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the timeout alert. Valid values:

- **true**: Enabled.
- **false**: Disabled.

parameters.name: TimeoutKillEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the timeout termination for the current trigger. Valid values:

- **true**: Enabled.
- **false**: Disabled.

parameters.name: Timezone
parameters.description: The time zone.

parameters.name: XAttrs
